title: Cross-Modal Latent Influence: Patch-Level Training Sample Attribution for Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.14190v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Explaining a vision--language model (VLM) prediction requires tracing training-example influence to the multimodal evidence that mediates it, yet existing attribution methods largely operate only at the sample level. Recent latent-mediated influence methods provide feature-level attribution in language models, but lack the multimodal and spatial structure needed to ground influence in VLMs. We introduce MOSAIC (Multimodal Orthogonalized Sparse Autoencoders for Influence Characterization). It learns a shared sparse image--text latent space whose concepts are 1) sparse within each modality, 2) supported on contiguous image regions, 3) aligned to the phrases that describe them, and 4) approximately decorrelated. It then applies EK-FAC to decompose training-example influence through these concepts and localize their contributions to specific text phrases and image regions. translated_title: 跨模态潜在影响：面向视觉-语言模型的补丁级训练样本归因
translated_abstract: 解释视觉-语言模型（VLM）的预测需要将训练样本的影响追溯到介导该影响的多模态证据，然而现有的归因方法大多仅在样本层面运作。最近的潜在中介影响方法虽然为语言模型提供了特征级归因，但缺乏将影响落地到VLM所需的多模态和空间结构。我们提出了MOSAIC（用于影响表征的多模态正交化稀疏自编码器）。它学习一个共享的稀疏图像-文本潜在空间，其概念具有以下特性：1）在每个模态内部稀疏；2）由连续的图像区域支撑；3）与描述它们的短语对齐；4）近似去相关。随后，该方法应用EK-FAC通过这些概念分解训练样本的影响，并将其贡献定位到特定的文本短语和图像区域。我们在Qwen和Gemma模型上，跨图像描述生成、胸部X光等任务对MOSAIC进行了评估。
tldr: 提出MOSAIC方法，通过构建稀疏、区域对齐、短语对齐且去相关的共享图像-文本潜在空间，并结合EK-FAC影响分解，首次实现了视觉-语言模型训练样本影响在图像区域（补丁）和文本短语级别的细粒度跨模态归因。
en_tdlr: MOSAIC learns a shared sparse image-text latent space with region-grounded, phrase-aligned, and decorrelated concepts, combined with EK-FAC influence decomposition, to enable the first patch-level cross-modal training sample attribution for vision-language models.
